lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical lines visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is wider on the posterior flank (approx. 50-60 pixels) and narrows to approx. 20-30 pixels toward the mid-torso region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped topological split is visible on the 4th line from the posterior, located in the mid-flank region where the line bifurcates into two ventral segments.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 9th, 10th, and 11th lines from the posterior are abbreviated, terminating in the mid-lateral region before reaching the ventral hair fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4-5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the upper posterior hind limb and haunch area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the mid-haunch align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line segment.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a lyrate trajectory, diverging from the skull at approx. 35 degrees before curving inward toward the terminal apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the horn tips is 1.2x the combined pixel width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 10% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white facial markings including a transverse chevron between the orbits and dual white spots on the lower mandible.
